{"candidates":[{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Place the day predicate in a filtered CTE before route aggregation.","sql":"WITH selected_trips AS (
  SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
)
SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM selected_trips
GROUP BY 1, 2"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Move the predicate into the aggregate and exclude groups with no qualifying trips.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips
FROM trips
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Aggregate by route and day first, then filter days and combine counts, preserving the BIGINT result type.","sql":"WITH daily_routes AS (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff,
         EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_day,
         COUNT(*) AS day_trips
  FROM trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT pickup, dropoff, CAST(SUM(day_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips
FROM daily_routes
WHERE pickup_day <= 7
GROUP BY 1, 2"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Filter rows before computing route counts with windows, then retain one row per route.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff,
       COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips
FROM trips
WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) = 1"}]}
